"""Plain-text invoice renderer producing fixed-width lines of at most 72 columns.

Tax rule (implemented EXACTLY as documented here):

    For each line item, compute the exact tax ``extended_price * tax_rate``
    using ``decimal.Decimal`` arithmetic and round THAT PER-LINE amount to
    cents using ROUND_HALF_UP.  The invoice tax is the SUM of the per-line
    rounded taxes.

    Note this is deliberately NOT "round the summed exact tax": with rates
    that land lines on an exact half-cent, the two rules can differ by 1
    cent.  This module always uses the per-line rule.

Money amounts are quantized to cents with ROUND_HALF_UP everywhere.
"""

from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP

CENT = Decimal("0.01")
WIDTH = 72

# Line-items table layout (0-indexed character slices of each row):
#
#   qty   [0:5)    right-aligned, width 4
#   desc  [6:37)   left-aligned, width 31 (30 chars max + '~' marker if cut)
#   unit  [38:50)  right-aligned money, width 12
#   ext   [51:64)  right-aligned money, width 13
#
# All rows are 64 chars; totals rows right-align their amount into the
# same [51:64) slice so the decimal points line up with EXTENDED.


def _dec(value) -> Decimal:
    """Coerce str/int/float/Decimal to Decimal without float artifacts."""
    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
        return value
    return Decimal(str(value))


def _fmt_money(amount: Decimal) -> str:
    return format(amount.quantize(CENT, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP), "f")


def _fmt_qty(qty: Decimal) -> str:
    if qty == qty.to_integral_value():
        return str(int(qty))
    return format(qty.normalize(), "f")


def _truncate(description: str) -> str:
    """Cut description at 30 chars, appending '~' as a truncation marker."""
    if len(description) > 30:
        return description[:30] + "~"
    return description


def _rate_percent(rate: Decimal) -> str:
    return format(rate * 100, "f")


def render(invoice: dict) -> str:
    """Render *invoice* to a 72-column-max plain-text string (trailing \\n)."""
    lines = []

    # --- header block ---
    lines.append(invoice["company"])
    left = f"INVOICE #{invoice['invoice_number']}"
    right = f"DATE: {invoice['date']}"
    lines.append(left + " " * (WIDTH - len(left) - len(right)) + right)
    lines.append("")

    # --- bill-to block ---
    lines.append("BILL TO:")
    bill_to = invoice["bill_to"]
    lines.append(bill_to["name"])
    for addr_line in bill_to.get("address", []):
        lines.append(addr_line)
    lines.append("")

    # --- line items table ---
    lines.append(
        f"{'QTY':>4}  {'DESCRIPTION':<31} {'UNIT PRICE':>12} {'EXTENDED':>13}"
    )
    lines.append(f"{'-' * 4}  {'-' * 31} {'-' * 12} {'-' * 13}")

    rate = _dec(invoice["tax_rate"])
    subtotal = Decimal("0")
    tax_total = Decimal("0")  # sum of PER-LINE rounded taxes (see module doc)
    for item in invoice["items"]:
        qty = _dec(item["qty"])
        unit = _dec(item["unit_price"])
        ext = (unit * qty).quantize(CENT, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
        # Documented rule: round half-up PER LINE, then sum.
        tax = (ext * rate).quantize(CENT, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
        subtotal += ext
        tax_total += tax
        lines.append(
            f"{_fmt_qty(qty):>4}  {_truncate(item['description']):<31}"
            f" {_fmt_money(unit):>12} {_fmt_money(ext):>13}"
        )
    lines.append(f"{'-' * 4}  {'-' * 31} {'-' * 12} {'-' * 13}")

    # --- totals block (amounts share the EXTENDED column slice) ---
    lines.append(" " * 51 + "-" * 13)
    lines.append(f"{'SUBTOTAL':<51}{_fmt_money(subtotal):>13}")
    tax_label = f"TAX ({_rate_percent(rate)}%)"
    lines.append(f"{tax_label:<51}{_fmt_money(tax_total):>13}")
    lines.append(f"{'TOTAL':<51}{_fmt_money(subtotal + tax_total):>13}")

    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
